rules.rule: The style dimension is delegated to web:style; never re-derived
must: the whole style dimension is delegated to\s+it

rules.rule: A defect that is both style and correctness is reported once, under correctness
must: is reported once, under correctness, with the higher\s+grade, naming the style rule id it also breaks

rules.rule: The review runs no tooling; it names the commands it ran
must: run no Biome, `vue-tsc`, Vitest, Playwright, or Go\s+tooling while reviewing
Name every command this pass ran, as run, in one report line

rules.rule: The API contract is checked for all, the root, or a diff touching either side
must: The API contract is in scope for `all`, for the root, and for any target or\s+diff touching the API client module or a Go file that serves its paths

rules.rule: A contract finding cites the TS and the Go side; a match yields nothing
No Go code serving the paths: skip, never guess the shape
must: Never guess a server's shape from the frontend alone

rules.rule: A behavioural bug is reproduced red before the fix and green after
must: reproduce it before touching the fix
If no test can\s+reproduce it, do not apply the fix

rules.rule: A rule Biome enforces goes in the reference config, never the prose rulebook
must: Nothing goes in the prose rulebook

rules.rule: No rule is written without confirmation
must: never write a rule without confirmation

rules.rule: Every Check run closes with Learn's scan of the session's feedback, writing only what the user picks; fan-out workers never run it
must: Close every completed Check run with Learn mode's scan
a fan-out worker never runs it
